1.title: Information We Collect
1.content: We collect information you provide directly when registering, such as name, email, grade level, and specialization. We also collect usage data automatically, such as visited pages, session duration, device type, and browser.

2.title: How We Use Your Information
2.content: We use your data to provide personalized academic path recommendations, improve your experience on the platform, and send service-related updates. We will not use your data for paid advertising or sell it to third parties.

3.title: Data Sharing
3.content: We do not sell or rent your personal data. We may share it with trusted service providers (such as Supabase for data hosting) who are committed to strict privacy policies.

4.title: Data Retention and Deletion
4.content: You can request to delete your account and data at any time through your account settings. We retain data as long as your account is active, and we may retain some logs for no more than 90 days after deletion for legal purposes.

5.title: Cookies
5.content: We use necessary session cookies for authentication and anonymous analytical cookies to understand usage patterns. You can disable them through your browser settings.

6.title: Data Security
6.content: We use SSL/TLS encryption for all communications and store passwords in a hashed format. We regularly review our security measures.

7.title: Your Rights
7.content: You have the right to access, correct, delete, and restrict the processing of your data, in accordance with applicable laws. Contact us via email for any requests.

1.title: Acceptance of Terms
1.content: By using the TawjihiPath platform, you agree to comply with these terms. If you are under 18, please obtain parental consent.

2.title: Description of Service
2.content: The platform provides academic and career guidance tools for Tawjihi students, including: skills assessment, field and major exploration, and path recommendations. The service is for guidance purposes only and is not a substitute for formal academic advising.

3.title: Account Creation
3.content: You must provide accurate information when registering. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials. Creating multiple accounts for a single person is prohibited.

4.title: Acceptable Use
4.content: It is prohibited to use the platform for illegal purposes, attempt to breach systems, violate intellectual property rights, or share misleading or harmful content.

5.title: Intellectual Property
5.content: All content, designs, and algorithms on the platform are the exclusive property of TawjihiPath. Copying or distributing them without prior written permission is prohibited.

6.title: Disclaimer
6.content: The recommendations provided are purely advisory. The platform is not responsible for academic or career decisions based on assessment results. Results are based on data entered by the user.

7.title: Amendments to Terms
7.content: We reserve the right to amend these terms at any time. We will notify you of any material changes via email or in-app notice 7 days before implementation.

8.title: Termination of Service
8.content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account in the event of a breach of these terms. You can delete your account at any time from your profile settings.

9.title: Governing Law
9.content: These terms are governed by the laws in force in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.
